title: Ethereal Vault
loadError: The vault could not be read.
offBody: The Ethereal Vault keeps a record of every worthwhile drop so nothing is lost when the pack is full. It is switched off here (the loot.vault knob is 0), so nothing new is recorded. Anything recorded earlier stays readable and nothing is deleted.
emptyBody: The Ethereal Vault keeps a record of every worthwhile drop, with its quality and level, so nothing is lost when the pack is full. Nothing has been recorded for this hero yet. Items appear here as the bot finds them, and you decide later what to keep.
carryReveal: Reveal it first: an unidentified charm gives nothing.
okCarry: In your backpack, marked keep. Stow puts it back in the vault.
okStowElsewhere: Out of the backpack; the vault could not take it, so it is in your {where}.
equipNone: Could not read the equip data.
equipReveal: Unidentified: reveal it first, then equip.
equipWorse: Looks weaker than what is worn
equipRecall: Recall now: walk home at the next safe moment
recallBtn: Do it now: go to town

recallStates.waiting: Going home as soon as it is safe: {why}
recallStates.arrived: In town: the order runs now

recallSent: The hero is told to go to town now.
equipUnid: Unidentified: it can be worn as it is (the affixes apply unseen); wearing does not reveal it.
equipWaitField: The hero is in the field: it wears this in town. Tap Do it now to go home at the next safe moment.
wearSetMax: A set is two to twelve pieces. The first piece for a slot is worn; the others stay in the vault and the reply says why.
okEquipSet: Wearing {n} pieces in this town stop. Pieces for a slot that is taken stay in the vault.
equipNoteDirect: Worn at once, in town or in the field. The item you replace goes into the vault as a record, the slot stays yours until you change it. Charms and belt or backpack items are not equipped here.
equipNote: Only in town, one town visit. The item you replace goes back into the vault, the slot stays yours until you change it. Charms and belt or backpack items are not equipped here.

equipStates.withdrawing: Taking it out of the vault

equipFailed: Not worn: {why}. If it was taken out it is in your backpack.
keepNowWhy: Walk home at the next safe moment and create the queued items
keepNote: Keep needs the Keep queue, which this bot does not have
keepQueuedHint: Arrives at your next town visit
okKeep: Queued {n}. They arrive at your next town visit.
okKeepNow: Queued {n}. The hero walks home at the next safe moment.
okKeepAlready: {n} already queued or kept; nothing changed.
upgradeWhy: Capacity upgrades need the vault switched on (loot.vault)
overBanner: Over capacity: discard {over} to resume recording ({n} are held). Nothing is deleted.
fullBanner: Vault full {n}/{cap}: new drops are not recorded
fullBannerTrim: The vault is full. The next worthwhile drop will trim the least valuable unpinned item.
markedText: Marked for sale: {n} ({names}). Nothing is sold until you confirm.
offWhy: The vault is off, so nothing here can be changed.
offBanner: Read only: nothing new is recorded and nothing can be changed while loot.vault is 0.
detailEmpty: Select an item to see its card.
discardBody: The vault keeps an archive copy of everything it removes, recoverable for 14 days. This takes the item out of the vault list.
okDiscard: Discarded {n}. The archive keeps a copy.

refusals.off: The vault is read only right now.
refusals.state: That item is no longer in the vault list.
refusals.pincap: The pin limit is reached; unpin something first.
refusals.ids: Send between 1 and 150 items at a time.
refusals.dead: The hero is dead; Keep works again once it is alive and in town.
refusals.verbs: This d2d build has no vault verbs (it must start with --vault-verbs).
refusals.stopped: Keep is stopped for this run.
refusals.target: Keep to the stash or the backpack only.
refusals.internal: The vault could not save the change.
refusals.pinned: Pinned items are never sold; unpin it first.
refusals.in-use: The vault holds {count} records and the lower tier fits {fits}: discard {over} first.
refusals.out-of-order: Only the last bought step can be refunded.
refusals.maxed: Every capacity step is already owned.
refusals.nothing-to-refund: No capacity step is owned, so there is nothing to refund.
refusals.wallet: The wallet could not save the change.
refusals.token: The page is not signed in for changes; open it from the watch screen again.
refusals.origin: This page may not change the vault from here.
refusals.content-type: The request was not sent as JSON.
refusals.method: The request used the wrong method.

revealNote: Reveal needs the identify step, which this bot does not have
revealEtherOr: . Or with Ether: {cost} (you have {have}), no scroll used
revealNone: Nothing selected can be revealed (identified, queued or gone).
buyScrollsWhy: Ask the hero to buy identify scrolls at the next town visit (the bot never does this on its own)
okBuy: Asked the hero to buy identify scrolls.

sellWhyWords.room: {n} do not fit in the stash

sellInstantBody: The items leave the Vault now and the gold is added to your stash at once. Stash after: {after} ({stash} + {gold}).
sellInstantRoom: The stash holds at most 2,500,000 gold.
sellValue: Sell value {gold} gold (the price the engine pays)
okSold: Sold {n} items for {gold} gold. Stash gold: {stash}.
sellNote: Sell needs the sell step, which this bot does not have
sellBody: At your next town visit the hero sells them at the vendor for about {gold} gold (the real price may differ). Pinned items are never sold. You can cancel a queued sale before then.
sellNone: Nothing selected can be sold (pinned, queued or gone).
okReveal: Queued {n} to reveal. They are identified at your next town visit.
okRevealNow: Queued {n} to reveal. The hero walks home at the next safe moment.
okSell: Queued {n} to sell. The hero sells them at your next town visit.
okSellNow: Queued {n} to sell. The hero walks home at the next safe moment.
revealQueuedHint: Identified at your next town visit
sellQueuedHint: Sold at your next town visit
sellSoldUnknown: Sold (the price could not be read)
promptText: Short by {short} gold for repairs and supplies: sell {n} vault item(s) (about {gold} gold)?
upgradeBody: Adds {add} slots: capacity {from} becomes {to}. It costs {price} {cur}; you have {bal}, {after} after. You can refund the last step later while the vault fits the lower capacity.
downgradeBody: Gives back step {step} for {refund} {cur} ({bal} becomes {after}). Capacity goes from {from} to the lower tier; the vault holds {count} records, which fit. Nothing is deleted.
okDowngrade: Refunded. Capacity is now {capacity}. {balance} {cur} in the wallet.
etherAlready: That step was already bought; nothing was charged.

revealBar.label: Reveal items
revealBar.title: Reveal {n} items in this filter
revealBar.confirmGold: Pay {cost} gold from your stash to reveal {n} items?
revealBar.nothingPayable: Nothing can be paid right now.
revealBar.cancel: Cancel the gold reveal (before it is paid)
revealBar.sent: Gold paid from your stash and the items are revealed.

identifyAllBody: Identify {n} items for {cost} gold? Stash {stash}, left after: {after}
identifyAllShort: Identify {k} of {n} for {cost} gold (stash {stash}): the rest later
identifyAllSkipped: {n} could not be read from the game just now and stay unrevealed.
identifyAllRunning: A gold reveal is still running
sellAllArm: Tap again to sell {n} items for {gold} gold (stash {stash} -> {after})
sellAllArmFull: Sell {n} of {all} for {gold} gold: stash full (stash {stash} -> {after}). Tap again
sellAllArmQueue: Tap again to queue {n} items for your next town visit
sellAllTitle: Sells everything in the Vault that is not pinned, kept or already in an order. Two taps.
sellAllQueuedToast: Queued {n} items to sell at your next town visit.
sellAllNothing: Nothing in the Vault can be sold now: {why}.
goldShort: Not enough gold in the stash ({price} each, you have {stash})

cmpAria.off: Compare with equipped gear: off. Press to compare with your hero.
cmpAria.hero: Compare with equipped gear: hero. Press to compare with your merc.
cmpAria.merc: Compare with equipped gear: merc. Press to turn compare off.

cmpNoData: Could not read what is worn right now.
cmpNotWorn: This item is not worn, so there is nothing to compare.
cmpMercNo: Merc cannot wear this (a {kind} cannot use that, or no merc slot takes it).
cmpTakesOff: Takes off {name} (a two-hander uses both hands)
cmpUnid: Unidentified: only the base stats are compared.
